name: Nagypeterd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagypeterd: a red shield with a yellow horseshoe, a star and a green tree, with a black border, above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYPETERD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
